source_image: Tonsil31plex_Scan1.qptiff (25200 x 15360 px, 0.5074 um per pixel, 32 channels, uint8)
how_chosen: scripts/score_example_regions.py scored 1344 candidate 1 mm regions (step 250 um); this was the best. Full list of the 10 best: example_region_scores.json. The engine check on the crop: 61 tissue windows, TOX -> CD163 flagged. Pairs with CD21 are not tested because CD21 is near-blank in this section (near-blank channels are excluded by rule); a pair that was tested and came out clean is CD3e -> CD38 (same cycle, both bright).
